projection.reason: The registry is technical machine-readable metadata. Human-facing knowledge may derive from it, but cannot overwrite it.

scope: initial candidate or provisional maturity assignment
approval for entry into this registry
excluded_actions: promote an insight to established without new multi-context evidence
delegation.override_rule: The project owner may revise or revoke any delegated decision. Later contradictory evidence must create a governed revision rather than silent overwrite.

validated_requires: direct verification of the generalized mechanism in a governed application

write_rules: run screening or full distillation before registry write
prefer occurrence or revision over duplicate creation
validate the registry after every change
